fields.acquisition_status: Final source row records local_checksums_verified after raw and normalized checksum verification; this does not mean a live download succeeded today.
fields.assertion_count: Number of eligible source records merged into this ordered interaction; repeated pathway or provider rows can increase it.
fields.citation: Dataset-level citation URL copied from acquisition/normalization metadata; not pair-level experimental evidence.
fields.completeness: Canonical definition completeness verdict after every declared member resolves; complete does not certify biological validation.
fields.complex_key: Source-local normalized definition key over source, species, label, relationship and ordered member identifiers/labels.
fields.complex_label: Original source complex or dependency-group label; it is not a gene symbol.
fields.dataset_provenance: Acquisition asset provenance such as native or orthology-derived; asset-level labeling may be less specific than per-record evidence.
fields.dataset_species: Species scope assigned to the acquired file; shared assets can contain multiple or unknown endpoint species.
fields.definition_id: D:-prefixed hash of source and normalized complex_key; joins a source definition to canonical entity membership.
fields.description: Explanatory workbook prose written by the pipeline, not biological evidence.
fields.direct_publication_count: Count of distinct evidence.value strings with type pubmed across eligible assertions; overlapping databases do not add independent replications.
fields.display_label: Readable canonical entity label chosen during same-species resolution; labels are not primary keys.
fields.disposition: Final policy result: primary/companion support a merged interaction; review/excluded/provenance_only remain auditable but do not support it.
fields.entity_id: E:-prefixed species/type/identity hash. Entities can be genes, molecular peptides, whole complexes or explicit proxies.
fields.entity_type: Canonical entity class: gene_product, complex, encoded_peptide, nonprotein_proxy or nonprotein_molecule where actually resolvable.
fields.evidence_key: Hash of normalized record_key, evidence type, exact value, provider and source field; repeated claims across records retain separate keys.
fields.evidence_provenance: Per-record native_reported, provider_orthology or unknown. Native_reported is a provider claim, not independent verification of experiments.
fields.exclusion_reasons: Normalized exclusion flags, retained without deleting the source assertion; do not add overlapping flag counts as distinct rows.
fields.gene_id: Same-species NCBI Gene ID, stored as text. For encoded peptides it identifies the precursor gene, not the molecular ligand.
fields.group_label: CellChat regulator group named by the interaction field; separate from required complex members.
fields.identity: Canonical identity serialization used to make entity_id: stable gene IDs or exact symbols, source molecular IDs, or complete member/role/stoichiometry/context tuples.
fields.interaction_id: I:-prefixed hash of species, ordered ligand_entity_id, receptor_entity_id and tier. Noneligible assertions/evidence have no supporting interaction_id.
fields.is_directed: Nullable positive source direction assertion. True reports direction; null is no positive assertion, not proof of an undirected interaction.
fields.is_inhibition: Nullable positive source inhibition assertion. A reversed PPI does not inherit the original sign; null does not mean stimulation.
fields.is_stimulation: Nullable positive source stimulation assertion. Null does not mean inhibition, false or absence of biological signaling.
fields.ligand: Ligand display label: canonical in interaction views, normalized source label in Assertions/Review. Join by entity ID, not this text.
fields.limitations: Pipeline-generated interpretive limitations on an entity or eligible interaction, including unverified symbols or missing direct references.
fields.mapping_basis: First successful deterministic same-species entity resolution basis; later source assertions retain their own identifiers in normalized records.
fields.mapping_status: Regulator identity result: same_species_resolved or unresolved_regulator. An unresolved optional regulator does not become a required subunit.
fields.member_entity_id: Canonical child entity ID: required subunit, proxy dependency, encoded_by gene or separate regulator member according to its table and role.
fields.member_id: Original member identifier in namespace; not necessarily an NCBI Gene ID and not always resolved.
fields.member_label: Original source member label, including optional CellChat regulator members.
fields.member_order: One-based order of a member in its original source definition; ordering alone does not establish stoichiometry.
fields.membership_id: Unprefixed 32-character deterministic canonical parent/member/relationship/stoichiometry key; identifies a dependency edge, not an interaction.
fields.namespace: Identifier vocabulary supplied by the adapter (e.g. symbol, UniProt, NCBIGene, HGNC, MGI, GtoPdb); interpret member_id in this namespace.
fields.normalized_assertions: Number of normalized source records, before final policy disposition; counts all retained statuses.
fields.normalized_review_reasons: Original normalization flags copied unchanged to final assertions even when accepted policies resolve them; final reasons controls disposition.
fields.orientation: Interpretation of source ordering: established ligand-to-receptor, reversed-to-ligand/receptor, or explicit unresolved/source direction labels.
fields.product_id: Source molecular product identifier where available. A proxy without a product ID is not assigned its enzyme gene as a molecule identifier.
fields.provenance: Sorted distinct evidence_provenance labels across eligible assertions; a merged interaction can have multiple evidence origins.
fields.provider: Source-provided evidence attribution, when present; can differ from the dataset source that distributed it.
fields.provider_summary_publication_count: Distinct PMID-like values in evidence types containing pubmed other than direct pubmed; provider-summary links are counted separately.
fields.raw_json: Compact JSON of the complete original source row. Values become strings/null recursively; whitespace/case and literal source missing-value spellings are preserved where loaded.
fields.reasons: Final unresolved identity/scope/exclusion reasons after accepted policies; empty for eligible primary/companion assertions.
fields.receptor: Receptor display label: canonical in interaction views, normalized source label in Assertions/Review. A whole complex can occupy this endpoint.
fields.record_key: Normalized source-row identity hash of source, source_file, source_table, textual source_row and source_record_id. One final assertion per record.
fields.regulator_id: R:-prefixed hash of source, normalized regulator row index and its complete original fields.
fields.related_interaction_id: Optional navigation link from a noneligible assertion to an existing eligible endpoint pair. This link never adds evidence or source counts.
fields.relationship: Dependency role: required_subunit, encoded_by or source biosynthetic/proxy roles. Source-Members retains original claims, including unknown stoichiometry labels.
fields.review_reasons: Normalization policy questions and interpretation warnings; these are not automatically final exclusions.
fields.role: CellChat optional regulator category from agonist, antagonist, co_A_receptor or co_I_receptor; not required complex membership.
fields.selection_json: Exact acquisition version-selection object serialized as JSON, including commit/release or provider selection metadata.
fields.semantic_key: Source-local hash of endpoint IDs/namespaces/types/species/complex keys and orientation, excluding file/row location; used for distinct source counts, not cross-source merging.
fields.sign_basis: Source-specific explanation of sign preservation or withholding, separate from a claim of ligand/receptor orientation.
fields.sign_summary: Aggregate positive eligible sign assertions: unknown, stimulation_reported, inhibition_reported or conflicting_positive_assertions.
fields.source: One of the 16 registered provider IDs; this is the distributing dataset, not necessarily an independent originating experiment.
fields.source_complex_key: Original normalized complex_key retained on a final canonical definition.
fields.source_count: Number of distinct eligible distributing datasets in sources; LIANA constituent rows are not counted as independent sources.
fields.source_field: Exact upstream evidence column or adapter-declared lookup descriptor; interpret with source and the source mapping below.
fields.source_file: Path relative to data/sources locating the immutable original asset.
fields.source_label: Original label on a canonical definition, retained even when the display label or resolved membership differs.
fields.source_record_id: Provider interaction ID where supplied; absent when the source has no row-level ID.
fields.source_row: Textual original row/index retained by the adapter: usually spreadsheet/text row, sometimes named R index; not a universal zero-based offset.
fields.source_table: Worksheet or nested R-object location; empty string denotes a flat/default table and is meaningful, not a missing field.
fields.sources: Sorted distinct eligible source IDs that support the merged interaction.
fields.species: Species of the canonical entity/dependency or normalized member; no cross-species identity conversion is performed.
fields.species_basis: How endpoint species was assigned (dataset, explicit fields or same-molecule source lookup). Missing partner species is not imputed.
fields.species_group: Agreement classification of endpoint species: human, mouse, unknown_species, mixed_species, cross_species or other_species.
fields.status: Normalization-only state: candidate, review or excluded. Candidate is not synonymous with final primary eligibility.
fields.stoichiometry: Known member copy count stored as text; null means unknown. Unknown is not one, and incompatible known counts preserve separate complex identities.
fields.stoichiometry_context: Original assembly-context serialization preserved when source stoichiometry cannot be reduced safely to the exact endpoint members.
fields.supporting_definition_ids: Canonical definition IDs whose complete required-member sets support a GtoPdb receptor complex interpretation; structural support, not extra interaction evidence.
fields.tier: primary for eligible gene-encoded ligands/receptors; companion for eligible explicit nonprotein/proxy ligands.
fields.type: Evidence vocabulary distinguishing direct pubmed, embedded provider-link PMIDs, source text, database/aggregate memberships, pathway and other retained source evidence.
fields.underlying_sources: Original underlying database labels exposed for aggregator overlap; these are not automatically counted as independent supporting datasets.
fields.value: Original or parsed evidence value; namespace and meaning are determined by type. PubMed IDs are text without an invented publication URL.
fields.ligand_label: Ligand: Original cleaned source endpoint display label; no case conversion.
fields.ligand_id: Ligand: Source endpoint identifier; use the accompanying namespace, never infer it from numeric appearance.
fields.ligand_namespace: Ligand: Source endpoint identifier namespace assigned by the adapter.
fields.ligand_type: Ligand: Normalized source endpoint class; unresolved and potential_enzyme_proxy values can precede final review.
fields.ligand_mapping: Ligand: Normalized identifier resolution basis, which can be source_symbol_unverified, source_lookup, source_identifier, ambiguous or unresolved.
fields.ligand_species: Ligand: Explicit normalized endpoint species list; [] means unknown, multiple entries remain mixed without expansion.
fields.ligand_complex_key: Ligand: Link to the intact source-local membership definition; null for endpoints without such a definition.
fields.ligand_entity_id: Ligand: Resolved canonical entity foreign key; can be null on noneligible assertions when identity resolution failed.
fields.receptor_label: Receptor: Original cleaned source endpoint display label; no case conversion.
fields.receptor_id: Receptor: Source endpoint identifier; use the accompanying namespace, never infer it from numeric appearance.
fields.receptor_namespace: Receptor: Source endpoint identifier namespace assigned by the adapter.
fields.receptor_type: Receptor: Normalized source endpoint class; unresolved and potential_enzyme_proxy values can precede final review.
fields.receptor_mapping: Receptor: Normalized identifier resolution basis, which can be source_symbol_unverified, source_lookup, source_identifier, ambiguous or unresolved.
fields.receptor_species: Receptor: Explicit normalized endpoint species list; [] means unknown, multiple entries remain mixed without expansion.
fields.receptor_complex_key: Receptor: Link to the intact source-local membership definition; null for endpoints without such a definition.
fields.receptor_entity_id: Receptor: Resolved canonical entity foreign key; can be null on noneligible assertions when identity resolution failed.
fields.original_endpoint_a: Original endpoint A label before any ligand/receptor reorientation; source punctuation and case remain in raw_json.
fields.original_id_a: Original endpoint A identifier before reorientation; interpret using the source mapping.
fields.original_role_a: Original endpoint A role assigned from source layout, retained when normalized orientation reverses.
fields.original_endpoint_b: Original endpoint B label before any ligand/receptor reorientation; source punctuation and case remain in raw_json.
fields.original_id_b: Original endpoint B identifier before reorientation; interpret using the source mapping.
fields.original_role_b: Original endpoint B role assigned from source layout, retained when normalized orientation reverses.

source PPI sign; retained in raw_json if LR orientation is reversed/unresolved
